chunks: Insulting a believer is wickedness, fighting a believer is disbelief, consuming his flesh is an act of disobedience to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and the sanctity of his wealth is like the sanctity of his blood.

key_terms.حُرْمَةُ مَالِهِ: the inviolability and sanctity of his property
key_terms.سِبَابُ الْمُؤْمِنِ: insulting or abusing a believer verbally
key_terms.كَحُرْمَةِ دَمِهِ: like the sanctity of his blood and life
key_terms.مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: disobedience to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about insulting, fighting, backbiting, and violating the property of a believer?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly condemns violating the dignity, safety, and rights of a believer. It treats verbal abuse, violent aggression, backbiting, and unlawful violation of property as grave moral offenses, emphasizing the sanctity of the believer in Islamic teaching.
